title: What Coffee Actually Does To Your Brain
description:
Caffeine does not give you energy. It blocks a chemical that makes you feel sleepy. Here is exactly what happens inside your brain 10 minutes, 45 minutes and 6 hours after that first cup.

Made with AI assistance.

#coffee #caffeine #science #brain #health

scenes.narration: Coffee does not give you energy. That is the first thing to understand. Nothing in that cup adds fuel to your body.
While you are awake, your brain builds up a chemical called adenosine. Every hour it stacks higher, and that pressure is what you experience as tiredness.
Caffeine looks almost identical to adenosine. So it slips into the same receptors and blocks them. The tiredness is still there. You just cannot feel it anymore.
Ten minutes in, your pupils dilate and your heart rate climbs slightly. Forty five minutes in, adenosine production fully stops and you hit peak alertness.
Six hours later, half the caffeine is still in your bloodstream. That afternoon coffee at three is still working at nine tonight.
And here is the trap. Since the adenosine was only blocked, never cleared, it comes back all at once. That is the crash. You were never tired. You were just borrowing from tomorrow.
